adapter.description: The adapter that connects the chat to your backend.

density.description: The vertical spacing density of chat messages. When provided, wraps descendant components with ChatDensityProvider. - 'compact' – Reduced vertical spacing between messages. - 'standard' – Default spacing. - 'comfortable' – Increased vertical spacing between messages.

features.description: Runtime feature flags for the chat controller (e.g. outbound typing signals).

localeText.description: The props used for the locale text slot.

onData.description: Callback fired when a data part is received.

onError.description: Callback fired when an error occurs.

onFinish.description: Callback fired when the assistant finishes a response, including when it is aborted, disconnected, or fails.

onToolCall.description: Callback fired when the assistant calls a tool.

partRenderers.description: Custom renderers for message parts, by part type.

slotProps.description: The props used for each component slot.

storeClass.description: The store class to use for this provider.

streamFlushInterval.description: Flush interval in milliseconds for batching rapid streaming deltas before applying them to the store.

variant.description: The visual layout variant of the chat. When provided, wraps descendant components with ChatVariantProvider so message and conversation components can respond to the variant. - 'default' – Standard layout with avatars, individual timestamps, and full spacing. - 'compact' – Messenger-style layout: no avatars, author + timestamp in group header, tighter spacing.

slotDescriptions.root: The component that renders the root.
